title: Hearty Slovakian Noodle Pilaf
description: A nutty and silky Slovakian dish featuring baking powder and binchotan-charcoal, perfect for a crowd, this lacto-vegetarian-friendly meal is made in a kadhai.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a kadhai over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they are tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the noodles, baking powder, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the sour cream and shredded cheddar cheese, and stir until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Place the binchotan-charcoal piece on top of the noodle mixture and cover the kadhai with a lid.
Let it smoke for 5 minutes, then remove the charcoal and serve hot.
Stir the noodle mixture well before serving.
Serve the Hearty Slovakian Noodle Pilaf hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
